papers.title: ConVAWG: A Retrieval-Grounded Framework for Controlled Synthetic Dialogue Generation in Violence Against Women and Girls
papers.abstract: Synthetic dialogue generation offers a way to study conversational dynamics in sensitive domains where real data are difficult to access, release, or annotate. The underlying abuse may occur online or offline: threats and coercion can appear directly in messages, while behaviours such as surveillance, isolation, stalking, and physical violence may be planned, disclosed, or referred to conversationally. Privacy and legal constraints make it difficult the release of large-scale real conversation datasets; existing work has mostly focused on sentence-level toxicity of online abuses, leaving a gap in modelling abuse as a relational and temporally unfolding phenomenon. In this work, we focus on modelling Violence Against Women and Girls (VAWG) scenarios as multi-turn dialogues. We introduce ConVAWG, a retrieval-grounded framework for generating CPS-aligned synthetic VAWG chat dialogues. ConVAWG builds scenarios from persona seeds, demographic patterns reported by the UK Office for National Statistics, official crime definitions, and retrieved Domestic Homicide Review cases; converts them into hierarchical event timelines; generates multi-scene role-play dialogues; and applies targeted activation-steered toxicity control to appropriate utterances. We release over 6,000 multi-turn dialogue events across 200 scenarios with rich scenario-, event-, and turn-level metadata. Extensive human evaluation, LLM-as-Judge assessment, ablations, and downstream tasks show strong dialogue quality and domain fidelity.
papers.summary_zh: 针对VAWG敏感领域真实对话数据难以获取、现有研究仅关注句子级毒性而忽视对话关系性与时间展开性的问题，提出检索增强的合成对话生成框架ConVAWG。该框架基于人物种子、人口统计模式、官方犯罪定义及家庭凶杀审查案例构建场景，生成层级事件时间线与多场景角色扮演对话，并采用激活导向的毒性控制。实验表明ConVAWG生成的对话在质量与领域保真度上表现优异，并发布了包含6000多轮对话事件的大规模数据集。
papers.summary_en: Real conversation data in the sensitive VAWG domain are difficult to access, and existing work focuses on sentence-level toxicity, neglecting abuse as a relational and temporally unfolding phenomenon. We introduce ConVAWG, a retrieval-grounded framework that builds scenarios from persona seeds, demographic patterns, official crime definitions, and retrieved review cases, converts them into hierarchical event timelines, generates multi-scene dialogues, and applies activation-steered toxicity control. Extensive evaluations show strong dialogue quality and domain fidelity, and we release over 6,000 multi-turn dialogue events across 200 scenarios.
highlights_zh: 检索增强+层级事件时间线生成
6千多轮对话，质量与保真度双优
提供丰富元数据，助力VAWG研究

papers.title: Beyond a Bag of Features: Set-Level Instability in Sparse Autoencoders
papers.abstract: Shani et al. (2026) show that LLM representations broadly recover human category boundaries, while failing to reflect fine-grained typicality structure. Their analysis uses cosine similarity over dense model representations. We revisit their approach using overlap over active sparse autoencoder (SAE) latent sets as a more interpretable similarity measure. We first verify that this set-level measure is meaningful: SAE latent sets can recover union-like compositional structure in controlled toy models and induce semantically coherent neighborhoods in natural text. Extending the human-concepts analysis to SAE set similarities, we find that SAE activation sets do not recover human category boundaries or within-category typicality more faithfully than dense embeddings or residual-stream states, but instead track model-internal similarity structure. To probe this gap further, we study active latent sets under well-controlled semantic modifications, revealing a substantial mismatch between human judgements of conceptual change and change in the SAE active set. We interpret this as evidence that, outside idealised settings, SAE features do not compose via simple bag-of-features semantics.
papers.summary_zh: 现有研究用密集表示余弦相似度分析LLM概念边界，但缺乏可解释性。本文提出用稀疏自编码器（SAE）激活潜变量集合的重叠度作为相似度度量，并在玩具模型和自然文本中验证其组合语义。结果显示SAE集合相似度并未更好恢复人类类别边界或典型性，反而反映模型内部结构，表明SAE特征在非理想化场景下不遵循简单词袋组合语义。
papers.summary_en: Prior work uses cosine similarity over dense representations to analyze LLM concept boundaries, lacking interpretability. We propose set-level overlap of active sparse autoencoder (SAE) latents as a similarity measure, validating its compositional semantics in toy models and natural text. Results show SAE set similarities do not better recover human category boundaries or typicality, instead tracking model-internal structure, indicating SAE features do not compose via simple bag-of-features semantics outside idealized settings.
highlights_zh: 提出SAE集合级相似度度量
SAE未优于密集表示恢复人类概念
揭示SAE特征组合语义局限

papers.title: Test-Time Self-Evolving GUI Visual Grounding via Reflection-Guided On-Policy Self-Distillation
papers.abstract: GUI Visual Grounding is a fundamental capability for GUI agents. Existing models typically freeze their parameters after deployment, limiting their ability to adapt to unseen interfaces. Although recent methods attempt to adapt models via test-time reinforcement learning, they cannot reflect upon failed exploration. To overcome this, we propose a Test-Time Self-Evolving framework that enables models to improve after deployment without human-annotated ground truth. It constructs a closed-loop of Exploration, Evaluation, Reflection, and Internalization. Specifically, the agent first explores unseen interfaces by predicting grounding coordinates for given instructions. To evaluate these explorations, we introduce an MLLM-based Reflector to assess the generated results and provide the corresponding reasoning reflections. To internalize reflection knowledge into the model weights, we propose Reflection-Guided On-Policy Self-Distillation, which translates high-level reasoning into dense token-level supervision via a conditioned self-teacher. Furthermore, we design a Contrastive Calibration method to prevent incorrect auto-regressive prefixes from corrupting the supervisory signals during failed explorations. Extensive experiments across six benchmarks demonstrate our framework's effectiveness, achieving an average accuracy improvement of 7.4% over the base model. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to successfully exploit on-policy self-distillation for test-time adaptation in GUI visual grounding. By filling the gap in post-deployment adaptation, our framework completes the self-evolving capability of GUI agents. The code will be released.
papers.summary_zh: 现有GUI视觉定位模型部署后参数冻结，难以适应未见界面，且测试时强化学习方法无法反思失败探索。本文提出测试时自进化框架，通过探索-评估-反思-内化闭环，利用MLLM反思器生成推理反馈，并采用反思引导的在线策略自蒸馏将高层推理转化为密集token级监督，配合对比校准防止错误前缀污染。在六个基准上平均提升7.4%，首次成功将在线策略自蒸馏用于GUI视觉定位的测试时适应，填补了部署后自适应空白。
papers.summary_en: Existing GUI visual grounding models freeze parameters after deployment, struggling with unseen interfaces, and test-time RL methods cannot reflect on failed explorations. This paper proposes a test-time self-evolving framework with an exploration-evaluation-reflection-internalization loop, using an MLLM-based reflector and reflection-guided on-policy self-distillation with contrastive calibration to convert reasoning into dense token-level supervision. It achieves 7.4% average accuracy improvement across six benchmarks, marking the first successful use of on-policy self-distillation for test-time adaptation in GUI grounding.
highlights_zh: 反思引导在线策略自蒸馏
填补部署后自适应空白

papers.title: From Interpretability to Control: Insights from Six Years of the TrustNLP Workshop
papers.abstract: The Workshop on Trustworthy Natural Language Processing (TrustNLP), co-located with major ACL conferences since 2021, has grown from 8 proceedings papers to 41 over six editions, documenting a field-wide transition from post-hoc interpretability of static models to mechanistic understanding and proactive control of generative systems. We synthesize insights from all 144 proceedings papers, classifying them along six trust dimensions grounded in established frameworks (TrustLLM, DecodingTrust). We observe co-occurrences with capability emergence. The release of the first high-impact chat models activated all trust dimensions simultaneously, while subsequent model generations shifted focus toward truthfulness and safety alignment. Analysis from the classification study reveals that truthfulness is the fastest-growing dimension (absent in 2021-2022, comprising 37% of papers by 2025-2026), fairness remains the most consistent theme, and explainability exhibits a U-shaped trajectory; declining as post-hoc methods lost relevance but resurging in 2026 through mechanistic interpretability. A cross-venue comparison with ACL, NAACL, EACL, and EMNLP (~2K papers) in the same period shows that TrustNLP's topical distribution closely follows the field average. We identify four structural insights and conclude with actionable directions for the research community.
papers.summary_zh: 可信NLP领域正从静态模型的事后解释转向生成式系统的机制理解与主动控制，这一转变在TrustNLP研讨会六年间（2021-2026）的144篇论文中清晰可见。我们基于TrustLLM和DecodingTrust框架，对全部论文按六个信任维度进行分类，并对比同期ACL等主会约2000篇论文，揭示了各维度随模型能力涌现的演变规律。研究发现真实性是增长最快的维度（2025-2026年占37%），公平性最稳定，可解释性呈U型轨迹（因事后方法失效而下降，后经机制可解释性在2026年复兴），且TrustNLP的主题分布与领域平均水平高度一致。
papers.summary_en: The trustworthy NLP field has shifted from post-hoc interpretability of static models to mechanistic understanding and proactive control of generative systems, a transition clearly documented across 144 papers from six editions of the TrustNLP workshop (2021-2026). We classify all papers along six trust dimensions grounded in established frameworks (TrustLLM, DecodingTrust) and compare against ~2K papers from ACL/NAACL/EACL/EMNLP, revealing how each dimension evolved with capability emergence. Truthfulness is the fastest-growing dimension (37% of papers by 2025-2026), fairness remains most consistent, explainability shows a U-shaped trajectory (declining then resurging via mechanistic interpretability in 2026), and TrustNLP's topical distribution closely mirrors the field average.
highlights_zh: 六维分类框架揭示信任演变
真实性维度增长至37%最快
可解释性呈U型复兴轨迹
